lines.en: The bottles at my waist clink as I walk.
My hem drags across the fungal carpet.
Careful, that puddle is my brew.
Every four seconds, I offer you a sip.
Steady steps; the mixtures must not spill.
Mycelium creeps out from my sleeves.
I have spilled too much on this road.
A witch's bones still carry me.
Come closer; my aim is poor.
Three bottles knock together behind me.
My shadow stays on the fungal stain.
Out of the way, I am off to brew.
I count the bubbles in my bottles.
Four seconds are up. Who wants a taste?
The recipe still lacks a strand of mycelium.
The wound under my sleeve slowly closes.
My foul spit turns sour on my tongue.

lines.zh: 我记得自己做女巫的样子。
lines.en: I remember when I was a witch.
This body does not fear poison.
Someone is staring; I can smell it.
The potion turns over inside its bottle.
Do not touch the green bottle.

lines.zh: 我在等视线对上的一刻。
lines.en: I wait for our eyes to meet.

lines.zh: 菌斑替我记着每次施法。
lines.en: The spores remember every spell I cast.
My throat feels stuffed with wet moss.
Quiet; the brew is fermenting.
Three bottles hang between my fingers.

lines.zh: 菌丝从我的腕上爬到瓶口。
lines.en: Hyphae crawl from my wrist to the bottle mouth.

lines.zh: 我还能想起念咒的调子。
lines.en: I still recall the chant's rhythm.
The moment our eyes meet, I throw.
My gaze has stuck to you now.
Meeting my eyes costs you a potion.
Let me check how much health you have.
Do not blink; I am aiming.
Your face is turning green already.
That look says you want my potions.
Stand still; do not run so fast.
Three bottles. How many can you dodge?
Rust clings to your sleeve.
No one I stare at gets far.
One more glance, and it begins.
I have memorized your shadow.
One of my bottles shattered.
You ruined my sleeve.
I am used to this much pain.
The brew spilled; I must start over.
My mycelium is pulling back.
Not the face; I still have brewing to do.
You hit harder than I expected.
This body does not take hits well.
I will remember this blow.
Blood in the potion. Such waste.
Hand me the potion you carry.
That purple one. I want it.
Stop shaking it; I cannot read the label.
I can trade you mycelium for it.
A witch's brews, all of them mine.
Put the bottle down and step back.
This smells like something I brewed.
Give it here and I throw one less.
You could never mix this yourself.
I smell that sweet fermented tang.
You knocked them over. Replace my brew.
Do not shove; the bottles will break.
My robe snagged on the fungus.
Make way; I am covered in potions.
You stepped on my fungal patch.
One touch means three days of poison.
Back off; I do not want to spill it.
This frame of mine is not sturdy.
Not so close; it will burn you.
One of my stoppers came loose.
The mycelium stitches us together.
My spores settle on your shoulder.
Two witches, one cauldron.
You brew, and I keep watch.
Do not tell anyone the recipe.
Our fungal patches join into one.
Your hands are a little warmer.
Let us paint this wood green.
I know the smell of your spores.
Half of my bottles are yours.
This bottle belongs in my cauldron.
Shiny. Can I brew with it?
I found a fine bone.
Never mind what I picked up.
This cap is still usable.
My pockets are soaking wet.
A glass bottle, just what I lacked.
Pick it up; do not waste material.
This could serve as a starter.
I tuck it inside my robe.
You. Step into my line of sight.
Target fixed; bottles ready.
I smell that you are hurt.
Hiding behind a tree will not help.
This one goes into my brew.
All three bottles are saved for you.
I see the gap in your armor.
Run, and I throw one more.

lines.zh: 今天的材料自己送上门。
lines.en: Today's material delivers itself.

lines.zh: 记住我的脸，快忘不掉了。
lines.en: Remember my face; you soon will not.
Arm up, aimed at your throat.
Wind drifts left; I adjust.
Do not shift; I am measuring paces.
Four seconds, only four left.
My fingers drip with acid.
You dodge left. I knew that.
Two steps closer would be perfect.
Do not turn your back; that is too easy.
The bottle mouth is on you.
An opening always shows. I can wait.
One scratch numbs you for hours.
My nails are packed with spores.
Up close, you cannot dodge.
Do not think I only throw bottles.
This palm carries poison.
Your armor cannot stop mycelium.
I tore your sleeve open.
My hands hold potions and teeth.
Back away; do not make me bite.
You are bleeding. Perfect.
Another body wakes up.
The cauldron is here; the fire still burns.
The mycelium moves first, then I do.
Who dug me out of the soil?
I remember my last body.
The fungus here is not thick enough.
The bottles are still full. Good.
There is the smell of the living.
I rise out of the fungal patch.
The witch died; I remain.
Let me look over this wood first.
Do not fear. It is only me waking.
Fire eats through my mycelium.
Every bottle broke when I landed.
Water thins all my potions.
The blast still rings in my ears.
An arrow sticks in my bottle rack.
This magic is not from my cauldron.
I forgot to keep a potion for myself.
Lightning split my cauldron.
Not even fungus grows down there.
